consolidation_prompt_policy: Base consolidation defers candidates whose complete system and user messages exceed 900000 UTF-8 bytes. Record byte counts and the reason in updates.json without a consolidation chat call or memory write. Preserve full evidence and continue subsequent candidates; the byte budget is not a token estimate.
parent_source: Reuses src/base/pipeline.py and the existing AppWorld launcher, executor, worker and completed-task recovery. Each run preserves actual MetaWeft and sibling working-source snapshots, including uncommitted changes, preset JSON, prompts and descriptors. No copied retrieval implementation or runtime exploration imports.
hypothesis: Improved candidate selection and procedural-utility ranking may improve ordered AppWorld task outcomes relative to base retrieval under the same execution and evolving-memory protocol. Retrieval-only recall does not establish downstream gains.
intended_differences: Select pre-task retrieval through one compatible preset. Keep final retrieval k=5, base adaptation, execution, reflection and consolidation unchanged. Resolve a preset-specific setting and variant ID per run; base selects its original descriptor and settings.
memory_structure: Base's flat per-stream Elasticsearch records with stable IDs, when_to_use, content, source evidence references and combined 1024-dimensional text-embedding-3-large vectors. Preserve complete records, vectors and mapping in checkpoints.
retrieval: Use the selected identity-query, combined-vector preset unchanged. Candidate search and ranking depths are independent of the final five memories passed to adaptation. V2 retrieval uses its own provider retry policy and ranking model/thinking controls; other stages retain base settings. Empty memory avoids paid retrieval calls; listwise ranking bypasses banks below 20 while configured grading still runs. exact_base retains its 225-memory capacity and fails above it. Consolidation retains its separate five-neighbor search.
adaptation: Base's single task-conditioned adaptation pass over retrieved records, including usable degraded ranking fallbacks. No within-task retrieval refresh or additional adaptation loop.
execution_context: Base executor prompt and ReAct interaction mechanics; qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.9, model seed 0, thinking disabled, 40 interactions, one trial and AppWorld random seed 100. Adapted guidance enters the initial context once. Preserve shared official loading, evaluation and task-owned canonical logging.
evidence_update: Base reflection on task specification, full execution trace and scalar reward proposes at most three candidates. Sequential consolidation adds, skips, revises or defers using allowed supporting evidence. Complete confirmed updates and a verified memory checkpoint before advancing; no automatic deletion or capacity-driven eviction.
feedback_access: Ranking sees task instruction and candidate when_to_use/content under local indices; source evidence and evaluation labels are excluded. Adaptation sees the task and retrieved records. Reflection/consolidation may use preserved task specifications, execution traces and official scalar rewards. Private solutions and evaluator assertions remain evaluation-only.
memory_lifetime: Empty memory independently per fresh run and test split; ordered tasks share completed updates. Recovery restores the last committed memory into a new isolated index using saved source and settings. Writable benchmark state remains isolated; only the completed LLM response store is shared. no_cache is the default. No warm start, training, task parallelism or within-task resume.
failure_reporting: Preserve explicit degraded retrieval fallbacks and stage outcomes. Exhausted provider/cache calls, canonical logging failures and unavailable required checkpoints are fatal. Preserve incomplete-task evidence without restoring its partial memory updates. Account for all stages, retries and inherited attempts; separate cache hits and unknown usage/cost.
recovery_protocol: Existing recovery format 1 and immutable identity checks. Selected preset is the setting and output family, so automatic and explicit recovery cannot mix presets. The composed run descriptor embeds retrieval_meta and the retrieval-only preset descriptor as provenance; that nested descriptor does not define the end-to-end memory lifecycle.
